title: Vinyl Earned 2.5x More Than CDs—Then Outsold Them
hook: In 2022, vinyl beat CDs for the first time since 1987.
closing: Streaming dominates, yet listeners still pay extra for music they can hold.
question: Do you still own CDs?

segments.say: Vinyl earned two and a half times what CDs did in 2022. That had not happened since 1987.
Vinyl outsold CDs by count: 41 million records to 33 million. Physical music buyers chose the older format.
Streaming still captures 84 percent of music revenue in America. Vinyl's comeback survives inside a much larger digital shift.
